tools.name: search_award_availability
tools.description:
Query the AwardSecrets data set (award-travel intelligence, AI-augmented and derived from GDS inventory and lived award-travel experience; not scraped) for award (points/miles) seat availability on ONE route, ONE date and ONE airline. Returns the flights found with cabin and seat count.

IMPORTANT —

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_award_availability" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
